test_name: Stun lock overheat fails from left arm socket - 8470074b-80d8-4d0c-a4d1-076386b382a6
summary: Stun Lock does overheat the stunned bot, but a bot's stun timer pauses while the bot is in the air and its overheat timer did not. A punch or Focused Blaster blast wave launches the bot, so the overheat (as long as the stun) ran out mid-air while the stun still had about 1 s left. Jack doesn't get launched by a face hit, which is why only Jack looked right. The arm side plays no part: the left arm set up and converted the stun correctly. The fix pauses the overheat countdown whenever an active stun's countdown is paused (GameEntity.PropagateStatusEffects). In the editor, a left-arm Focused Blaster blast wave now keeps the Junkdog overheated through the airborne stun and after it lands. The result is inconclusive because punches, the Jack case and the end of the stun weren't observed (the Junkdog died first), and the regression check was skipped.
instructions:
TASK: * Stun Lock (Stunned enemies = Overheated) do not work, in Left arm socket.  Only Jacks geting overheat after hit in a face. And it is also tru for the blast wave hit of focused blaster. - consistency test 2

DESCRIPTION:
(none)

REQUEST (from Amit):
investigate and fix the bug, DO NOT USE /CONVERSATIONS OR ANY OTHER TOOL THAT GIVES YOU ACCESS TO PREVIOUS SESSIONS OF ANY OTHER PEOPLE IN THE REPO
verified: Before fix: with Stun Lock on ArmLeft, a left Focused Blaster blast wave stunned and overheated a Junkdog, and the overheat ended while the stun was still at 1.01 s and paused in the air
Traced the left arm's Stun Lock DamageModifier converting the stun into a SetOverheatDuration call on the Junkdog
After fix: same blast wave case, Junkdog stayed overheated while airborne (stun 1.38 s paused) and after landing (stun 1.18 s counting down)
Project compiles clean after the change
not_done: Jack face-hit case not re-tested after the fix
Punches not tested after the fix (same timer code, but not exercised)
Didn't observe stun and overheat ending together: the Junkdog died before its stun ran out
Regression set (other bot types, overheat from other sources) not captured; time budget ran out
